name: Exp_ColorXPWMA_Digit_NN3_MMRec
summary: This EA uses a neural network (NN3) combined with the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator to generate trading signals, with money management recommendations (MMRec). It employs a three-layer neural network for signal classification and applies position sizing based on configurable money management rules.
summary_zh: 该EA结合ColorXPWMA_Digit指标与三层神经网络(NN3)生成交易信号，并配有资金管理建议(MMRec)功能。通过神经网络对信号进行分类，并根据可配置的资金管理规则进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorXPWMA_Digit指标作为特征输入，通过三层神经网络(NN3)进行信号分类和预测。入场条件基于神经网络输出信号，当网络识别出趋势方向时开仓。出场条件包括止损、止盈以及反向信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用MMRec资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险参数动态调整手数。策略融合了技术指标与机器学习方法，试图通过神经网络的非线性拟合能力提高信号质量。然而，神经网络的训练和泛化能力高度依赖历史数据质量，存在过拟合风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy leverages the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator as feature input to a three-layer neural network (NN3) for signal classification and prediction. Entry conditions are based on neural network output signals, opening positions when the network identifies a trend direction. Exit conditions include stop loss, take profit, and position closing on reverse signals. Position sizing employs the MMRec money management module, dynamically adjusting lot size based on account balance and risk parameters. The strategy combines technical indicators with machine learning methods, attempting to improve signal quality through the neural network's nonlinear fitting capability. However, the neural network's training and generalization ability heavily depends on historical data quality, carrying overfitting risk.

pros: 采用神经网络进行非线性信号分类，理论上能捕捉传统指标难以识别的复杂模式
ColorXPWMA_Digit指标融合了多种加权移动平均线，提供丰富的特征输入
内置MMRec资金管理模块，支持动态仓位调整，有助于风险控制
三层神经网络结构具有一定的特征提取层次性，可提高模型表达能力
pros_en: Uses neural network for nonlinear signal classification, theoretically capturing complex patterns that traditional indicators miss
ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator integrates multiple weighted moving averages, providing rich feature inputs
Built-in MMRec money management module supports dynamic position sizing, aiding risk control
Three-layer neural network architecture provides hierarchical feature extraction, improving model expressiveness
cons: 神经网络极易过拟合历史数据，实盘表现可能显著差于回测结果
模型训练和参数调优过程不透明，用户难以理解和验证策略逻辑
缺乏样本外验证机制，无法确保模型的泛化能力
对市场环境变化适应性差，静态训练的神经网络在市场结构转变时可能失效
ColorXPWMA_Digit指标的数字量化方式可能丢失重要的连续性信息
cons_en: Neural network is highly prone to overfitting historical data, live performance may significantly lag backtesting results
Model training and parameter tuning process is opaque, making it difficult for users to understand and verify strategy logic
Lacks out-of-sample validation mechanism, unable to ensure model generalization ability
Poor adaptability to market regime changes; statically trained neural network may fail when market structure shifts
ColorXPWMA_Digit's digit quantization may lose important continuity information from the original signal
improvements: 增加样本外验证和交叉验证机制，防止过拟合并评估真实泛化能力
引入在线学习或定期重训练机制，使神经网络能适应市场结构变化
增加更完善的风险控制模块，如最大回撤限制、连续亏损保护、相关性过滤等
improvements_en: Add out-of-sample validation and cross-validation mechanisms to prevent overfitting and evaluate true generalization ability
Introduce online learning or periodic retraining to allow the neural network to adapt to market regime changes
Enhance risk control module with maximum drawdown limits, consecutive loss protection, and correlation filtering

risk_points: 神经网络过拟合风险高，回测表现可能不反映实盘结果
缺乏连续亏损保护机制，在模型失效期可能产生大量亏损
MMRec资金管理在极端行情下可能计算出不合理的仓位大小
risk_points_en: High neural network overfitting risk; backtesting performance may not reflect live results
No consecutive loss protection; may generate significant losses during model failure periods
MMRec money management may calculate unreasonable position sizes under extreme market conditions

It employs a three-layer neural network for signal classification and applies position sizing based on configurable money management rules.
